prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?

Professional interior painting in the greater St. Louis region typically costs $1 to $6 per square foot or $300 to $1,000 per individual room, depending on prep work, ceiling heights, and repairs. HomeGuide +1
